about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Leading the realization of GX through energy technology, contributing to smart cities and a carbon-neutral society.
about.visionDesc: Led by our CEO, an expert in urban and building energy diagnostics, we are driving R&D of AI/big data-based building energy platforms as our core business. We are building a sustainable future through smart city solutions and building energy reduction technologies.

about.orgSubtitle: Our four departments in business, development, and research work closely together to drive the research, development, and commercialization of energy technology.

orgItems.name: Business Div. 1
orgItems.desc: Oversees domestic building energy-saving consulting and green remodeling projects. Provides end-to-end services from energy audits of public and private buildings to energy reduction planning and BEMS implementation.

orgItems.name: Business Div. 2
orgItems.desc: Manages overseas market expansion in Japan, UK, France, and the US, along with smart city platform operations. Executes localization and PoC projects based on global partnerships.

orgItems.name: Development Dept.
orgItems.desc: Designs and implements the full spectrum of our products (Watti, Opti, etc.) — from web and app frontends to AI backends, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure.

orgItems.name: R&D Dept.
orgItems.desc: Conducts building energy big data analysis and AI/ML model research, and leads core technology patent filings and academic paper publications.
